description: Fix TOMLKit document editing so adding a top-level scalar after promoting a dotted key to a nested table preserves field scope on serialization.
acceptance: After parsing a document with dotted keys, adding a child table and then assigning a root scalar must serialize to valid TOML. Reparsing must keep the new scalar at the root and preserve the nested tables and their values.
The behavior must also work with deeper dotted keys, more than one new scalar, and existing root scalars or regular tables.
Keep the existing text and key order when appending a scalar to a document whose dotted keys still render inline. Preserve existing comments and values in unchanged lines.
Keep the public parse/dumps and mapping APIs. Do not modify the read-only app.py adapter.
